title.display: Canto: reconstruction of displaced tracks, trained on {tt} only.
title.speech: Canto: reconstruction of displaced tracks, trained on t t-bar only.

problem.display: Prompt tracks start at the collision point and leave a hit on every layer.
problem.speech: Prompt tracks start at the collision point and leave a hit on every layer.

problem.display: A long-lived particle flies out unseen and decays far from the collision.
problem.speech: A long-lived particle flies out unseen and decays far from the collision.

problem.display: Its tracks start late, with no hits on the inner layers.
problem.speech: Its tracks start late, with no hits on the inner layers.

problem.display: They do not point back to the beam line: a large impact parameter, d_{0}.
problem.speech: They do not point back to the beam line: a large impact parameter, d zero.

problem.display: Yet trackers and machine-learning pipelines are tuned on prompt tracks.
problem.speech: Yet trackers and machine-learning pipelines are tuned on prompt tracks.

pipeline.display: A collision leaves hits in the detector: points in space without labels.
pipeline.speech: A collision leaves hits in the detector: points in space without labels.

pipeline.display: Graph construction: edges join hits that may be consecutive on a track.
pipeline.speech: Graph construction: edges join hits that may be consecutive on a track.

pipeline.display: Edge classification: a graph neural network scores every edge.
pipeline.speech: Edge classification: a graph neural network scores every edge.

pipeline.display: Track building: edges above a threshold are grouped into track candidates.
pipeline.speech: Track building: edges above a threshold are grouped into track candidates.

dezoort.display: Interaction network: small MLPs on edges, R_{1} and R_{2}, and on hits, O.
dezoort.speech: Interaction network: small MLPs on edges, R one and R two, and on hits, O.

dezoort.display: Trained on {tt}, it cannot reach the fake-rate target: at best 12.5 %.
dezoort.speech: Trained on t t-bar, it cannot reach the fake rate target: at best 12.5 percent.

acorn.display: Metric learning: an MLP embeds each hit so that hits of one track sit together.
acorn.speech: Metric learning: an MLP embeds each hit so that hits of one track sit together.

acorn.display: A radius graph links hits within 0.16.
acorn.speech: A radius graph links hits within 0.16.

acorn.display: Then an interaction GNN scores the edges.
acorn.speech: Then an interaction GNN scores the edges.

acorn.display: Connected components of edges above a cut are the track candidates.
acorn.speech: Connected components of edges above a cut are the track candidates.

acorn.display: Trained on the HNL signal, our reproduction matches the paper on all tracks.
acorn.speech: Trained on the HNL signal, our reproduction matches the paper on all tracks.

failure.display: Pointing shortcut: a GNN seeing absolute positions learns that tracks point to the origin.
failure.speech: Pointing shortcut: a GNN seeing absolute positions learns that tracks point to the origin.

failure.display: Without their inner hits, prompt tracks lose edge TPR: the start radius matters.
failure.speech: Without their inner hits, prompt tracks lose edge TPR: the start radius matters.

failure.display: The {tt}-trained graph already misses displaced pairs.
failure.speech: The graph trained on t t-bar already misses displaced pairs.

failure.display: In dense jets, connected components merges neighbouring tracks: {tt} prompt efficiency is only 87 %.
failure.speech: In dense jets, connected components merges neighbouring tracks: t t-bar prompt efficiency is only 87 percent.

canto.display: A canto is built from interlocking tercets, linked by their rhymes.
canto.speech: A canto is built from interlocking [tercets](/tˈɜɹsəts/), linked by their rhymes.

canto.display: Likewise, a track is assembled from chained hit triplets: neighbouring triplets share two hits.
canto.speech: Likewise, a track is assembled from chained hit triplets: neighbouring triplets share two hits.

canto.display: The graph and the edge scores are learned; no HNL event is used in training.
canto.speech: The graph and the edge scores are learned; no HNL event is used in training.

classifier.display: Canto's messages come from hit triplets, a → b → c: two edges that share a hit.
classifier.speech: Canto's messages come from hit triplets, [a](/ˈA/) to b to c: two edges that share a hit.

classifier.display: Shift the production point or rotate the track: only a 6-region flag changes.
classifier.speech: Shift the production point or rotate the track: only a 6-region flag changes.

classifier.display: Training only: 30 % of {tt} particles lose their innermost hits.
classifier.speech: Training only: 30 percent of t t-bar particles lose their innermost hits.

classifier.display: dD probes large |d_{0}|; dT, missing inner hits.
classifier.speech: d D probes large d zero; d T, missing inner hits.

classifier.display: Inner-hit truncation removes both, for every architecture.
classifier.speech: Inner hit truncation removes both, for every architecture.
The Canto classifier: d D plus 2.4, d T minus 0.1.

branches.display: Canto-B: the {tt}-trained metric-learning graph, which can miss a displaced edge.
branches.speech: Canto B: the metric learning graph trained on t t-bar, which can miss a displaced edge.

branches.display: Canto-H adds wider-radius candidates with hand-cut helix-triplet support.
branches.speech: Canto H adds wider-radius candidates with hand-cut helix-triplet support.

branches.display: Canto-L learns the triplet support instead, and keeps more true edges.
branches.speech: Canto L learns the triplet support instead, and keeps more true edges.

branches.display: Both union graphs lift the ceiling to 0.9947.
branches.speech: Both union graphs lift the ceiling to 0.9947.

branches.display: The learned union needs fewer pairs, yet keeps more {tt} edges.
branches.speech: The learned union needs fewer pairs, yet keeps more t t-bar edges.

branches.display: Just a bigger graph? Without the filter, a larger radius adds pairs but little ceiling.
branches.speech: Just a bigger graph? Without the filter, a larger radius adds pairs but little ceiling.

branches.display: The same ceiling needs 53 % more pairs.
branches.speech: The same ceiling needs 53 percent more pairs.

trackbuild.display: Mutex Watershed: edges above s_{0} attract, same-layer hits repel; we merge greedily by score.
trackbuild.speech: [Mutex](/mjˈutˌɛks/) Watershed: edges above s zero attract, same layer hits repel; we merge greedily by score.

trackbuild.display: A second pass at a lower s_{0} attaches the leftover hits.
trackbuild.speech: A second pass at a lower s zero attaches the leftover hits.

trackbuild.display: Fragment merging joins pieces of a broken track.
trackbuild.speech: Fragment merging joins pieces of a broken track.

trackbuild.speech: Our builder alone lifts acorn to 0.969.
